feed_summary: Approving an AI service is only the starting point. As employees adopt Claude and their responsibilities change, security teams need to know who has access, which users hold administrative privileges, and whether those roles and group memberships still reflect the work they do. IBM’s 2025 Cost of a Data Breach Report found that, among studied organizations reporting an AI-related breach, 97% lacked proper AI access controls. The finding highlights a broader challenge: AI adoption needs security practices that extend beyond the initial approval, supported by information teams can use to review access with administrators and service owners. title: Who Has Access to Claude? Bring AI Identity and Access Context Into Surface Command
